title: Optimal Positioning of Local Anaesthetic in Femoral Nerve Block Prior to Hip Surgery
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to compare patient comfort and analgesic efficacy of ultrasound guided femoral nerve block using the following endpoints: circumferential spread, anterior or posterior local anaesthetic deposition prior to positioning for spinal anaesthesia for operative fixation of fractured neck of femur.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fractured neck of femur surgical fixation performed under spinal anaesthesia
* ASA I to III

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient refusal
* Coagulation disorders
* Head injury or other associated injuries
* Previous vascular surgery in the femoral area.
* Loss of consciousness and signs of acute coronary syndrome
* Mini-Mental Score \< 25 (see appendix 3)
* Allergy to lignocaine,
* Skin lesions/infection at site of injection
* Sepsis
